title: The Eternal Turn

features.name: the spiral that contains itself
features.desc-on-touch: A turning within the turning: each rotation opens into another rotation at a scale you can't quite perceive. The gyre has no center because the center is always rotating away from itself.

features.name: the markers of each turn
features.desc-on-touch: Small glyphs placed at the edge of the field, each one marking a place where the spiral has already passed. The markers are all equidistant from a center that doesn't exist.

features.name: the drift itself
features.desc-on-touch: The gyre is moving. Everything here is sideways relative to everywhere else. To walk straight is to walk in a spiral; to turn is to go straight.

inscription: the spiral that spirals infinitely is the same as the spiral that never begins, is the same as the spiral that ended before you arrived
